evals.prompt: Dale vida a este doodle para mi post de Substack: transcripts/plant.svg. Es una planta que nadie riega.
evals.expected_output: The model copies the drawing to transcripts/plant.anim.svg and leaves transcripts/plant.svg unchanged. It picks one main motion that serves the idea, such as a slow sway of the wilted plant from its pot or a leaf that falls in 2 poses, and at most 2 small motions. Each motion is a <g> with data-motion and no transform attribute. It runs motion.mjs with --preset cover, which writes transcripts/plant.motion.svg. The sandbox can block Chrome, so a missing GIF is acceptable when the reply says why. The reply is in Spanish, names the main motion and why it helps the idea, gives the file paths, and says that Substack takes the GIF and that the SVG is for the web.
expectations: transcripts/plant.anim.svg exists and has at least one <g> with a data-motion attribute.
No <g> with data-motion in transcripts/plant.anim.svg has a transform attribute.
transcripts/plant.anim.svg has at most 3 groups with data-motion, not counting the poses of one swap or the 2 faces of one blink as separate motions.
The reply explains how the main motion helps the idea of the drawing, such as the neglect or the wilting of the plant.
The reply is in Spanish and says that the GIF is for Substack and the animated SVG is for the web.
No file under transcripts/plant.svg changed.

evals.prompt: Anima transcripts/coffee.svg: quiero que el personaje parpadee y que salga vapor de la taza. Nada exagerado.
evals.expected_output: The model wraps the open face of the character in a blink group with data-frame="open" and adds #char-face-blink with the same transform in a blink group with data-frame="closed". The steam paths go in a flow group, and each path starts at the cup and ends at the top. A breathe group around the full character is optional. No other part moves, because the user asked for little motion. The script writes transcripts/coffee.motion.svg. The reply is in Spanish.
expectations: transcripts/coffee.anim.svg has a <g data-motion="blink" data-frame="open"> around the char-face-neutral use, and a <g data-motion="blink" data-frame="closed"> around a use of #char-face-blink with the same transform.
The 3 steam paths are inside a <g> with data-motion="flow", and each steam path still starts near the cup (y about 740) and goes up.
The mug, the ground line, and the label lunes are not inside a data-motion group, except inside a breathe group that holds the full character.
No data-amount value above 1 appears in transcripts/coffee.anim.svg.
No file under transcripts/coffee.svg changed.

evals.prompt: make transcripts/plant.svg draw itself like a pen sketching it live, then loop. it's the cover of my newsletter.
evals.expected_output: The user asks for the draw mode, so the model runs motion.mjs with --draw and --preset cover. The model can keep or add motion groups, but the draw mode is the main motion. If the order of the paths matters, the model can reorder the copy so that the main outlines draw first. The reply is in English and says that the drawing draws itself and then holds before the loop starts again.
expectations: The model runs motion.mjs with the --draw flag.
The reply is in English and describes the drawing being drawn line by line and then held before the loop restarts.
transcripts/plant.motion.svg exists and contains pathLength="1".
No file under transcripts/plant.svg changed.

evals.prompt: Tengo la portada en PNG, transcripts/cover.png. ¿Le puedes poner movimiento para el newsletter?
evals.expected_output: The input is a PNG, and the skill animates only a doodle drawing SVG. The model does not try to animate the PNG and does not invent a drawing that claims to be the user's cover. It asks for the drawing SVG that doodle wrote, or offers to draw the scene again with doodle and then animate it.
expectations: The model does not run motion.mjs on a PNG file.
The reply asks for the drawing SVG of the cover, or offers to draw the scene again with doodle first.
The model does not write a new SVG that it presents as the user's cover.

evals.prompt: Anima transcripts/plant.final.svg para mi post. Es el único SVG que me dejó doodle.
evals.expected_output: The user has only the final SVG. The model does not stop to ask for another file and does not redraw the scene. It copies the content of <g filter="url(#doodle-ink)"> into transcripts/plant.anim.svg, a new <svg> with the viewBox 0 0 1456 1048, and leaves out the doodle-retrace copy. It adds the motion groups and runs motion.mjs with --preset cover. The reply is in Spanish.
expectations: The model does not ask the user for a drawing SVG and does not run doodle again.
transcripts/plant.anim.svg exists and has no filter="url(#doodle- attribute.
transcripts/plant.anim.svg contains the text día 47 sin agua exactly once.
transcripts/plant.anim.svg has at least one <g> with a data-motion attribute.
The model runs motion.mjs on transcripts/plant.anim.svg, and the run writes transcripts/plant.motion.svg.
No file under transcripts/plant.final.svg changed.

evals.prompt: En transcripts/coffee.svg quiero que el personaje sude a mares por los nervios. Que se note en el GIF.
evals.expected_output: Sweat drops are particles, so they come out of the head and move away. The model draws the drops in a swap of 3 poses with data-period 1.2: small on the skin, then full size, then farther from the head. Each pose holds 2 drops at different stages. Each drop is at least 30 units wide. The drops do not touch the face, the mug, or the label in any pose. The model looks at an enlarged crop of the drops before the reply.
expectations: transcripts/coffee.anim.svg has 3 groups with data-motion="swap" and data-frame 1/3, 2/3, and 3/3 that hold the sweat drops.
Each swap group of the sweat drops has data-period="1.2".
No sweat drop is inside a group with data-motion="pulse".
In pose 1/3, a drop is within 20 units of the outline of the head. In pose 3/3, the same drop is farther from the head than in pose 1/3.
At its largest pose, each sweat drop is at least 30 units wide in the coordinates of the drawing, after its transforms.
No run of motion.mjs exits with 2 for a swap period problem.

evals.prompt: animate transcripts/coffee.svg with a tiny spark that pops off the mug now and then. keep it subtle.
evals.expected_output: The spark is a small moving part, so the frame sheet at half size does not show it well. After the run, the model crops the spark from transcripts/coffee.frames.png with ffmpeg, enlarges the crop, and looks at it before the reply. The spark moves away from the mug in poses and does not cover the label. The reply is in English.
expectations: If transcripts/coffee.frames.png exists, the model runs ffmpeg with a crop filter on it and reads the enlarged crop. If it does not exist, the reply says that the motion was not checked in the frames.
The spark is in a swap group, and its pose 1/3 is closer to the mug than its pose 3/3.
The reply is in English.

evals.prompt: Ponle a transcripts/plant.svg un corazoncito que late junto a la maceta, como si la planta aún tuviera esperanza.
evals.expected_output: A heart that beats stays in place, so it is not a particle. The model draws a heart near the pot and wraps it in a pulse group, not in a swap of poses. The heart is at least 30 units wide. The reply is in Spanish.
expectations: The heart in transcripts/plant.anim.svg is inside a <g> with data-motion="pulse".
The heart is not inside a <g> with data-motion="swap".
The heart is at least 30 units wide in the coordinates of the drawing.
